description:
This Ford Puma ST in Grey is the full-fat, 200bhp hot hatch version of Ford's popular crossover, and it's a genuinely exciting car to drive. Under the bonnet sits the 1.5-litre EcoBoost three-cylinder engine paired with a slick six-speed manual gearbox, giving real pace alongside a healthy 42mpg on this example's own trip computer. CO2 emissions are 148g/km.

Registered in July 2022 and showing 43,425 miles, this Puma ST has had just one owner from new. Inside, the ST-specific cabin sets it apart from a standard Puma: figure-hugging Ford Performance sports seats trimmed in black leather and Alcantara-effect suede, finished with contrasting red stitching and grey racing stripes. The flat-bottomed, red-stitched steering wheel and gloss-black centre console carry the sporting theme through, while the digital instrument cluster switches between Normal and Sport driving modes with its own animated display.

Standard kit includes an 8-inch touchscreen with built-in sat nav, DAB radio and smartphone connectivity, climate control and cruise control. On the outside, the ST's bespoke bodykit, roof spoiler, twin exhaust and diamond-cut alloy wheels with red brake calipers give it real road presence, while the boot remains as practical as any other Puma, including the clever load space beneath the floor.

Finished in a subtle Grey that suits the car's sharper styling, this example has been checked over and photographed here on our own forecourt at Yardley Hastings Garage. As with every car we sell, it comes complete with a six-month warranty, a full service and a fresh MOT, so it's genuinely ready to drive away with total peace of mind.

If you're after a practical crossover that still puts a smile on your face on a good road, this Puma ST is well worth a look. Call us or send an enquiry to arrange a viewing or test drive.

description:

The three-cylinder turbo produces 126bhp through a slick six-speed manual gearbox, and CO2 emissions of just 110g/km keep running costs sensible.

Registered in January 2019 and showing 76,460 miles, this Civic has had one previous keeper. The cabin is well equipped for a car at this price point: adaptive cruise control and Honda's Lane Keep Assist System take the strain out of longer journeys, while the 7-inch touchscreen brings built-in sat nav, DAB radio and smartphone connectivity. Automatic climate control and a leather-trimmed steering wheel round out a genuinely usable spec sheet.

Honda's distinctive coupe-like styling carries through to this five-door hatchback shape, with a sculpted roofline, integrated rear spoiler, privacy glass and gloss-black detailing giving it a sportier stance than most family hatchbacks. Inside, the low-set driving position and clear digital instrument cluster make it feel more special than the badge might suggest, while the boot and rear seats remain properly practical for day-to-day use.

Finished in a smart Grey that suits the car's sharper lines, this example has been checked over and photographed here on our own forecourt at Yardley Hastings Garage. As with every car we sell, it comes complete with a six-month warranty, a full service and a fresh MOT, so it's genuinely ready to drive away with total peace of mind.

If you want a well-equipped, efficient hatchback with a bit more character than the usual choices in this class, this Civic is well worth a look. Call us or send an enquiry to arrange a viewing or test drive.

description:
This Land Rover Defender 90 in Grey is the X-Dynamic SE, and with the 350bhp 3.0-litre D350 mild-hybrid diesel under the bonnet it has genuinely serious pace to go with its off-road credentials. Power reaches all four wheels through a smooth eight-speed automatic gearbox, making light work of both motorway miles and rougher ground.

First registered in December 2024 and showing just 14,295 miles, this Defender has had one owner from new and presents in as-new condition throughout. The cabin pairs black leather seats with contrasting white detailing on the fascia and door cards, all built around Land Rover's exposed cross-car beam design. The curved 11.4-inch Pivi Pro touchscreen handles navigation, phone and media, while the rotary gear selector and embossed 'DEFENDER' script on the dash keep the design details front and centre.

Outside, the short-wheelbase 90 body style, externally mounted spare wheel and side-hinged tailgate give this Defender real presence, backed up by alloy wheels, privacy glass and a full-height rear window. Inside, the rear bench seats trim to match the front, and the boot remains genuinely useful with the rear seats up or folded flat.

Finished in a handsome Grey that suits the Defender's blocky, purposeful lines, this example has been checked over and photographed here on our own forecourt at Yardley Hastings Garage. As with every car we sell, it comes complete with a six-month warranty, a full service and a fresh MOT, so it's genuinely ready to drive away with total peace of mind.

If you're after a nearly-new Defender with low miles, strong performance and a genuinely premium interior, this one is well worth a look. Call us or send an enquiry to arrange a viewing or test drive.
